summary: Available August 2024 · Three Bathrooms · West Jesmond
description:
My Property Box bring to the student market this fabulous three bedroom groundfloor flat on Holmwood Grove, Jesmond. Always a favorite with students, the modern flat boasts three double bedrooms along with a rare three bathrooms in the form of two en-suites and main bathroom. Communally there is a large central living room along with kitchen and private rear yard.

Alongside its rare layout, the property's West Jesmond location makes it a firm favorite with students. Being close to West Jesmond Metro station, Sainsburys and a short commute to both campuses, this flat is ideal for a trio who desire a spacious flat with more mature feel.
